name: 86 Chaos 16.0.10 Honest Presence Status Fix
label: 16.0.10 Honest Presence Status Fix
notes: Treats Online Now as a true fresh heartbeat within 90 seconds instead of anyone active during the 15-minute/active-today window.
Splits the System Administrator presence snapshot into Online Now, Recently Active, Active Today, and Last Seen counts.
Softens RTDB fallback warnings and keeps friendly Android/Windows/iPhone browser labels instead of raw user-agent strings.
